name: 05-payout-ledger
idea: A double-entry ledger and payout service for a marketplace. Sellers accumulate balances from orders, and on a daily schedule the service creates payouts to connected bank accounts. Every movement of money is a ledger entry with two sides; the sum of all entries is always zero. A payout is idempotent per seller per day: replaying the job must not move money twice. Refunds, chargebacks and reversals are modelled as compensating entries, never as edits to history. Operators need a view of an account's current balance derived from entries, not stored as a number. Regulated, multi-tenant, with a full audit trail of who did what.
